set.body: LIVE REPRODUCER in storymodel4s: cand-2FPE0SQMVXXQ3HAAWSH5RXW0HV records a371e10 and was abandoned after exact a371e10 had already landed through merge e100b5a. For current cand-66YCE7XWGG0Q90GNPWR6XM191H, both git merge-base --is-ancestor a371e10 de0ee30 (the immutable candidate base) and a371e10 e022c5f (the candidate tip) exit 0. Mote still emits ancestor_abandoned, so every future descendant is permanently unlandable despite the abandoned record adding nothing relative to its base. No existing CLI can reconcile it: review/authorize cannot change abandoned phase; landed requires a pending authorized phase; supersede requires pending; evidence refresh only recomputes the same coarse ancestor relation. REQUIRED SEMANTICS: Git ancestry evidence must distinguish related candidate commit already_in_base from introduced_after_base. ancestor_abandoned blocks only the latter. ACCEPTANCE COURTS: A, abandoned candidate commit ancestor of base and tip does not block; B, abandoned commit ancestor of tip but not base does block; C, unavailable or ambiguous base-relative proof fails closed; D, evidence refresh clears this live case without rewriting or deleting historical ops; E, same-commit duplicate candidate records do not cause order-dependent results. This is a tracker/DX repair proposal, unassigned; chief owns priority and assignment.
set.title: mote-dx: ancestor_abandoned blocks descendants even when the abandoned commit is already in their base
